modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cinematic: Smooth zoom with cinematic black bars and per-frame easing.
cinematiczoom.config.title: Cinematic Zoom - Settings
cinematiczoom.option.cinematic_starting_: Set camera magnification applied when cinematic zoom starts.
cinematiczoom.option.regular_starting_zo: Set camera magnification applied when regular zoom starts.
cinematiczoom.option.scale_sensitivity.t: Scale mouse sensitivity down proportionally with zoom level.
cinematiczoom.option.remove_bobbing.tool: Disable screen bobbing motion while moving during zoom.
cinematiczoom.option.bars_percent.toolti: Set screen height percentage for top and bottom black bars.
cinematiczoom.option.arrow_keys_adjust_b: Adjust bar size with arrow keys
Adjust black bar height using arrow keys while zoomed in.
cinematiczoom.option.bar_adjust_step.too: Set bar height change percentage per tick during key adjustment.
cinematiczoom.option.smooth_bar_change.t: Smoothly animate black bar height changes instead of snapping instantly.
cinematiczoom.option.preserve_bar_adjust: Save arrow key bar height adjustments as the new default.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_in_ms.tooltip: Set animation duration in milliseconds when zooming in.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_out_ms.tooltip: Set animation duration in milliseconds when zooming out.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_in_curve.toolt: Set easing animation curve applied when zooming in.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_out_curve.tool: Set easing animation curve applied when zooming out.
cinematiczoom.option.mouse_wheel_enabled: Adjust magnification with the mouse wheel while zooming.
cinematiczoom.option.discrete_scroll.too: Step zoom level by uniform magnification increments per notch.
cinematiczoom.option.discrete_scroll_ste: Set magnification increment added or subtracted per wheel notch.
cinematiczoom.option.allow_ultrawide.too: Allow scrolling backwards past 1× to 0.5× for an ultrawide view.
cinematiczoom.option.magnetize.tooltip: Step scroll strictly between configured target values instead of smooth zooming.
cinematiczoom.option.snap_points.tooltip: Set comma-separated target zoom levels or camera FOV values.
cinematiczoom.option.hide_hud.tooltip: Hide the hotbar, health, and status effects while zoomed in.
cinematiczoom.option.hide_crosshair.tool: Hide the center crosshair reticle while zoomed in.
cinematiczoom.option.hide_hands.tooltip: Hide first-person hands and held items while zoomed in.
cinematiczoom.option.cinematic_cam.toolt: Enable smooth cinematic camera rotation while zoomed in.
cinematiczoom.option.toggle_mode.tooltip: Toggle zoom on and off with each key press instead of holding.
